svg.title: Sample lineage of a checkout rework (acme/shop)
svg.desc: Example for the bbb-github-diag skill: an umbrella with three children, the pull requests that closed or replaced them, follow-ups, a block and a related pair.
svg.text: Checkout rework: what grew out of umbrella Checkout rework: cart, coupons and guest retry#100
Arrows point from the earlier item to the item it produced, or from an issue to the pull request that closed it. Read left to right.
Facts as of 2026-03-22. Dotted frames name an area of work only; the arrows carry the relationships.

svg.text: Arrows run from the earlier item to the later one;
blocked by, supersedes and related may point back.
Closed pull request, not merged: gray, red stripes, red cross.
Red cross on a closed issue: no merged pull request closed it.
Red new corner: added in the latest revision.
Bold lines are claims that hold now (blocks, found, not merged).
B is a formal child of umbrella A
B is the pull request that closed issue A
B worked on A without closing it
B was filed for what A left out
pull request A replaced B (B closed unmerged)
A cannot finish until B is done
